verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections as plain-text Bru files in a filesystem folder, which community users corroborate. Docs show folder-level structure alongside requests and collections. The Bru CLI (also in Docker and CI pipelines) reruns whole collections on demand, with data-driven automated runs. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on creating and nesting folders inside collections, and evidence of an in-app (GUI) collection runner for rerunning requests.
